_note: Provenance of every key of configs/r40-board-m2.cfg. 'image' = evidence/r40/v2/convergence/attempt03/image.tcl (the 3-core U280 image); RTL paths are rtl/...; 'derived' = cycle counts read from the RTL structure (state machines, pipeline stages), not measured; 'model' = model control, no hardware meaning; 'detailed path only' = used by memory_model=0, ignored by the timeline path; 'FIT' = fitted on the calibration split (fit_report.json).
outlets: image: MEM_PORTS 3 (slice s -> outlet s mod 3)
active_outlets: image default 3; TNCA_RTL_MEM_PORTS of a record overrides (1 = every slice on outlet 0)
outstanding: image: AXI_OUT_N 8 lines per outlet; TNCA_RTL_OUTSTANDING of a record overrides
clock_hz: qualified operating clock of the attempt03 image, 90 MHz (every board record's clock_hz)
memory_base: model: the runtime addresses device memory from 0
pc_bytes: model: HBM pseudo-channel byte counters only
pc_count: model: HBM pseudo-channel byte counters only
pc_first: model: HBM pseudo-channel byte counters only
noc_stages: derived: 3 cycles per hop (NOC_LINK_STAGES 2 elastic stages + router, rtl/noc/tnca_mesh.v, tnca_router.v)
hbm_latency_cycles: FIT: AXI/HBM read round trip behind an outlet (not in the RTL)
dma_queue: rtl/core/tnca_core.v stall_txf: one command in the transfer engine, the next waits in R
dma_setup_cycles: derived: rtl/core/tnca_tensor.v S_TSETUP/S_TCHK then S_TMUL one multiply per dimension (2 + rank)
dma_rf_cycles: derived: one window unit written per cycle
issue_cycles: derived: one instruction leaves R per cycle (tnca_core.v)
scalar_latency: derived: scalar ALU result usable at c+1
predicate_latency: M1 value (predicate ops; not separately derived)
reduction_latency: derived: integer reduction to scalar c+1
fp_reduction_latency: derived: FP reduction (fold through the FMA array) c+16
load_latency: derived: load-use = last response + 5 (tnca_lsu.v writeback path)
lsu_slots: detailed/non-pipeline path only (core_pipeline=1 uses the two LSU_INFLIGHT units)
mtx_rf_read_cycles: RTL matrix oracle: busy 2a+18K+6 with ABUF (rtl_oracle/matrix_oracle.py)
mtx_mac_cycles: RTL matrix oracle (16 MACs per K step, 1 cycle each)
mtx_zero_cycles: RTL matrix oracle: m.zero busy 17 = 16 + complete
launch_cycles: derived: rtl grid dispatch, first instruction ~5 cycles after launch_valid
dispatch_cycles: derived: next program 6 cycles after core idle (tnca_grid_dispatch.v)
host_launch_cycles: FIT: host time between launches of one call (median calibration inter-launch gap)
host_transfer_cycles: FIT: fixed cost per host transfer (not identifiable from the records; 0)
host_transfer_cycles_per_kib: FIT: host staging rate (median calibration per-kernel upload+download seconds per byte)
tl_noc_inject_cycles: derived: core NI injects in the request cycle (tnca_core_ni.v)
tl_slice_hit_latency: derived: hit response leaves at accept+4
tl_slice_mreq_occupancy: derived: MREQ, memory request at S+6
tl_slice_to_outlet_cycles: derived: MEM_HOME_STAGES/LINK_STAGES links to the outlet adapter (+4)
tl_outlet_to_slice_cycles: FIT (second latency parameter): memory data return path from the HBM adapter to the home slice, outside the outlet's outstanding window; RTL-derived value 5, fitted 13 on the calibration split (fit_report.json)
tl_outlet_read_issue_cycles: derived: rtl line AXI adapter issue stage, 2 cycles per read line
tl_hbm_write_latency_cycles: FIT: tied to hbm_latency_cycles (write response round trip)
core_pipeline: model: 1 = the RTL pipeline structure (parking, freezes, LSU units)
branch_taken_cycles: derived: a taken branch costs its context 4 fetch slots
park_refetch_cycles: derived: RCTX_SWITCH 2 parked context refetches 5 cycles after its wake
vrf_bank_conflict_cycles: derived: one read per bank per cycle (tnca_operand_collector.v)
lsu_vector_load_extra: derived: vector load one cycle after a scalar load
lsu_complete_cycles: derived: unit free after the last response
lsu_writeback_cycles: derived: an LSU completion takes the writeback port (wb_steal)
time_quantum: model: conservative lookahead cap (simulation speed; exact up to same-time ordering)
dram_path: model: DRAM path, 0 = fast (hbm_latency_cycles latency model), 1 = slow (Ramulator2); TNCA_DRAM_PATH=fast|slow overrides
dram_fixed_cycles: slow path only (dram_path=1); unused by this fast-path configuration
dram_clock_ratio: slow path: HBM clock / core clock = 900 MHz / 90 MHz (U280 HBM at 1.8 Gb/s, the qualified 90 MHz core clock)
dram_max_passes: slow path: at most 3 child passes per command (M3 design)
dram_tolerance_ppm: slow path: fixed point converged when two child makespans differ by < 0.5 % (M3 design)
